title: How to Create a TikTok Business Account in 2026: Step-by-Step Guide & Business Center Setup
summary: Learn how to create a TikTok Business Account, switch from personal, and set up TikTok Business Center. Compare business vs personal accounts and get expert tips for success.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is a TikTok Business Account free?


Yes, creating or switching to a TikTok Business Account costs nothing and requires no subscription fee. Expenses like advertising spend, commerce fees, and third-party services such as FastMoss are separate costs. Start with TikTok's built-in tools, then add paid services only if your workflow demands more data.


### What is the difference between a TikTok Creator and a Business Account?


A TikTok Creator Account is designed for individual creators who prioritize creative tools, while a Business Account is built for brands and organizations. Business Accounts get access to the Commercial Music Library and business-focused analytics. Choose Creator if you post as an individual, Business if you represent a store or organization.


### How many followers do you need for a TikTok business account?


TikTok Business Accounts have no follower minimum. You can create one from scratch or switch an existing profile at any time, regardless of audience size. The account type simply changes the tools available to you, not your eligibility.


### What is the downside of a TikTok business account?


The main tradeoff is music access: commercial posts must use tracks from the Commercial Music Library, which excludes popular licensed songs available to personal accounts. Before switching, consider whether your posting style depends on trending commercial music, since that restriction applies to brand content.


### What is the difference between a TikTok Business Account and TikTok Business Center?


A TikTok Business Account is your public-facing profile inside the app, while Business Center is a separate web-based workspace for managing ad accounts, team members, and permissions. You can run a Business Account without Business Center, but add it once agencies, staff, or paid campaigns require shared access.


### Can I switch my personal TikTok account to a business account without losing followers?


Yes, switching keeps your existing username, followers, and content intact. Open your profile, go to Settings and privacy, tap Account, then select Switch to Business Account and choose your business category. Starting a brand-new account makes sense only if you want a separate brand identity.


### What do I need before creating a TikTok Business Account?


Prepare a brand name, available username, profile image, short bio, contact details, and a business category. You also need a login method your organization can access, such as an email address or phone number, plus a secure password. Having these ready makes setup fast and keeps your profile recognizable.
